newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila probes bombing of power pylons.
newsitem.headline: Manila probes bombing of power pylons.

text.p: President Fidel Ramos on Sunday ordered the military to investigate the bombing and torching of power pylons in the southern Philippines and tighten security to prevent further attacks.
Unidentified groups have destroyed 11 power structures on the Mindanao island since the start of the year, disrupting supply of electricity to several provinces.

In one incident, suspected Moslem separatists fired rifle grenades to knock out a transmitter after an electric cooperative refused to pay "extortion money" - called "revolutionary taxes" by the guerrillas - a presidential palace statement said.

Police said they also suspected sabotage by dismissed workers of the state National Power Corp and by residents demanding right-of-way compensation for pylons built by the government over their farms.
